note: Pilot list. Each place is [OSM name to look for, rough lat, rough lon]; the router only accepts a place that matches by name in OpenStreetMap near that spot. mi = rough round-trip miles, used as a sanity check.

missing_in_osm.name: Wind Mountain
missing_in_osm.why: OSM has no summit point for Wind Mountain (checked 2026-11-08)

hikes.name: Multnomah and Wahkeena Falls Loop
hikes.blurb: The Gorge's signature waterfall loop: up past the top of Multnomah, across to Wahkeena Creek and down past Fairy Falls.

hikes.name: Angel's Rest
hikes.blurb: Short, steep climb through the 2017 burn to an exposed basalt point high over the river.

hikes.name: Devil's Rest via Angel's Rest
hikes.blurb: Angel's Rest, then on through quiet forest to the wooded high point behind it.

hikes.name: Larch Mountain from Multnomah Falls
hikes.blurb: The big one: from the falls all the way up Multnomah Creek to a crater-rim lookout with five volcanoes in view.

hikes.name: Sherrard Point (Larch Mountain)
hikes.blurb: A few minutes from the summit parking to one of the best volcano panoramas around Portland.

hikes.name: Latourell Falls Loop
hikes.blurb: Two waterfalls in an easy loop, the lower one dropping over lichen-yellow columnar basalt.

hikes.name: Wahclella Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy walk up Tanner Creek to a two-tiered falls in a deep, mossy bowl.

hikes.name: Eagle Creek to Punch Bowl Falls
hikes.blurb: Cliff-edge trail with cables up Eagle Creek to the classic emerald punch bowl.

hikes.name: Eagle Creek to Tunnel Falls
hikes.blurb: The full Eagle Creek: a string of waterfalls ending at a trail blasted through the cliff behind a 120-foot fall.

hikes.name: Dry Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: A quiet stretch of the Pacific Crest Trail from Cascade Locks to a falls pouring out of a basalt slot.

hikes.name: Elowah and Upper McCord Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: A blasted-rock ledge with railings high above Elowah Falls, to a twin falls above it.

hikes.name: Nesmith Point
hikes.blurb: A long, relentless climb to the highest viewpoint on the Oregon rim of the western Gorge.

hikes.name: Horsetail, Ponytail and Triple Falls
hikes.blurb: Behind Ponytail Falls, over Oneonta Creek and up to a falls split into three by the rock.

hikes.name: Hamilton Mountain Loop
hikes.blurb: Past Rodney Falls' Pool of the Winds to a summit and ridge facing Bonneville and the Oregon side.

hikes.name: Beacon Rock
hikes.blurb: Dozens of railed switchbacks up the core of an old volcano standing alone by the river.

hikes.name: Dog Mountain
hikes.blurb: A hard climb to meadows famous for spring balsamroot, with a long view up and down the river.

hikes.name: Silver Star Mountain via Ed's Trail
hikes.blurb: Open ridges, a rock arch and wildflower slopes to a summit with Hood, St Helens, Adams and Rainier.

hikes.name: Indian Point via Herman Creek
hikes.blurb: A steady climb from Herman Creek to a rock spire jutting off the Benson Plateau's rim.
